title: Angular developer
summary: Generates Angular code and gives architecture and best practice guidance for projects, components, services and more.
details: In an Angular project, Claude writes components, services and other Angular code, checks the project's Angular version before giving guidance, and runs ng build to check what it generated. It is for you if you build or maintain Angular apps. The pack copies a skill folder that loads only when used; instructions only, and the skill-overrides setting keeps this skill off by default.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
